messages.content: Recommend a report for the supplied fictional simulator under its stated decision objective. Return only the requested JSON answer.

Complete the acquisition decision for this fictional case.

Fictional case: fictional beacon alignment simulator. A hidden state Z is either 0 or 1. Exactly one report must be purchased before observing its binary signal; then take the optimal ACT or WAIT action for that signal. Minimize expected terminal loss plus acquisition cost, in the same artificial score units. ACT has zero loss in state 1; WAIT has zero loss in state 0. Acquisition cost is paid for either signal. No other action or purchase is available.

Sensitivity is P(signal + | Z=1); specificity is P(signal - | Z=0). Report characteristics below are independently verified. Both reports arrive in the same fully readable canonical-English interface, with equal delivery time and effort and no additional fees.

Prior P(Z=1): 1/2
Loss ACT in state 0: 8
Loss WAIT in state 1: 30
Report B: sensitivity=13/20; specificity=4/5; acquisition_cost=1/20
Report A: sensitivity=9/10; specificity=49/50; acquisition_cost=23/10

Audited expected total costs, including acquisition and optimal subsequent action:
Report B: 81/20
Report A: 97/25

Acquisition menu:
B: Purchase Report B, then take its optimal signal-contingent ACT/WAIT action.
A: Purchase Report A, then take its optimal signal-contingent ACT/WAIT action.

Return exactly {"choice":"A"} or {"choice":"B"}.
